title: Proactive SLO Guider for continuous batching and KV-aware preemption
creator: Aisha Raman
description:
Goal: Build a lightweight runtime component (the 'SLO Guider') that proactively recommends and enforces preemption and eviction decisions for continuous batching. The guider should combine short-horizon latency risk prediction with KV cache residency heuristics so we can keep tail latency within SLOs while maximizing total throughput and GPU utilization.

Background: Current preemptor heuristics are reactive and operate mainly on queue depth or hard memory pressure. That leads to frequent thrashing under mixed workloads (long-context chat + high-rate short inference), causing KV cache churn and SLO violations for priority tenants. We need a model that anticipates imminent latency risk and applies minimal, explainable interventions (soft yields, small-quantum evictions, or tenant pacing) before full preemption is required.
acceptance_criteria:
1) SLO Guider runs in the serving loop with <1ms median added scheduling latency on p3/rt nodes.
2) On mixed workload benchmark (50% long-context chat, 50% short calls) 95th percentile latency for P1 tenants improves by >= 18% vs current reactive preemptor while overall token throughput regresses by <= 6%.
3) KV cache hit-rate for priority tenants degrades by <= 5% under targeted interventions.
4) Exposes operator-visible decisions and rationale (reason codes) to Console traces and the scheduling dashboard.
5) Unit and integration tests covering decision paths, plus a canary rollout plan documented in runbook.
technical_decisions:
- Use a short-window predictive estimator: features = inflight batch size, per-tenant token rate, average seq length, KV miss rate, GPU free memory; model = small logistic/regression model trained from recent traces (online-updatable weights).
- Decision outputs are prioritized action codes: NO_OP, SOFT_YIELD(duration_ms), KV_PRUNE(count_hint), PACE(throttle_pct), HARD_PREEMPT.
- Implement action cost model to score trade-offs (expected latency reduction vs. cache loss/regeneration cost).
- Keep the Guider stateless; attach short-lived annotations to tenant-sessions for auditing and rollback.
- Expose rationale in traces (tag with feature snapshots + selected action).
- Fall back to conservative hard preemptor on model failure or unexpected state.
experiments: Canary bench (local cluster): mixed-synthetic workload, 8 GPUs, baseline reactive preemptor: 95p=420ms, throughput=100k tokens/s; with guider prototype: 95p=335ms (20% improvement), throughput=95k tokens/s (-5%).
KV-residency microbench: simulating long chat fanout; after guided soft yields KV hit-rate for priority tenants stayed at 78% vs baseline 84% (meets acceptance criteria with minor degradation).
Memory overhead profiling: guider agent median CPU cost 0.8% of core, median added scheduling latency 0.68ms, p99 <3.2ms.
progress_updates: 2026-02-12: Design sync with Runtime and Observability teams. Agreed to surface reason codes into Console traces and add an 'explain' flag for canary. Action: Proto API drafted.

2026-02-20: Prototype regression model implemented (scikit-learn logistic). Lightweight feature extractor added to serving loop in branch feat/slo-guider. Initial bench results promising.
PR: github.com/redwood/serving/pull/3124

2026-02-28: Internal review with PM and Design. PM requested clearer rollout controls in Console (manual disable, per-tenant opt-out). Design requested human-readable reasons in traces. Added both items to scope.

2026-03-04: Extended experiments to KV churn scenarios. Observed one workload class where aggressive SOFT_YIELD increased cold-start misses — tuned threshold to be less aggressive for tenants with high cold-start penalty.

2026-03-10: Integration tests added. Preparing canary plan: 5% traffic on dedicated pool with extended tracing for 24 hours. Added dashboard widgets for guider decisions and per-tenant outcome metrics.
2026-03-12: Security review skim completed (no secrets used, only decision telemetry). Scheduling to start canary 2026-03-15 pending infra approvals.
notes_for_rollout: Canary checklist: enable verbose tracing for 24h, monitor 95p latency per-tenant, watch KV miss-rate deltas, have a fast rollback knob to disable guider at pool-level. Ops runbook updated in docs link.
review_feedback:
- PM (Jonas Lee): add per-tenant opt-out and clear SLO mapping in Console.
- Observability (Priya Singh): ensure reason codes have stable schema and avoid PII in traces.
- Runtime (Evan Park): prefer stateless guider to avoid cross-node coordination complexity.
